description: Read the visible text of the current page, or report whether the browser is running and which tabs are open.
name: browser_read

max_chars.description: Truncate beyond this many characters. Default: 3000.

status.description: True to report the browser and its numbered tabs instead of page text. Default: False.

description: Convert a document to another format using LibreOffice.
name: convert_document

filename.description: Output name. Defaults to the documents folder. Default: ''.

open_after.description: Open the file when it is done. Default: False.

sections.description: One dict per section with 'heading' and 'body' text.

description: Build a PDF from a title and body text.
name: create_pdf

content.description: Body text. Blank lines separate paragraphs; a line ending in ':' is treated as a heading.

filename.description: Output name. Defaults to the documents folder. Default: ''.

open_after.description: Open the file when it is done. Default: False.

filename.description: Output name. Defaults to the documents folder. Default: ''.

open_after.description: Open the file when it is done. Default: False.

slides.description: One dict per slide with 'title' and 'bullets' (a list of strings).

title.description: Deck title, used for the opening slide.

filename.description: Output name. Defaults to the documents folder. Default: ''.

open_after.description: Open the file when it is done. Default: False.

sheets.description: One dict per sheet with 'name', 'headers' (list) and 'rows' (list of lists).

description: Show metadata for a file or directory: size, permissions, type, dates.
name: describe_file

path.description: The file or directory to describe.

description: Fetch a web page and return its readable text.
name: fetch_page

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of text to return. Default: 4000.

description: Search for files by name, newest first, and optionally by their contents.
name: find_files

content.description: Also require this text to appear inside the file. Default: ''.

name.description: Filename or glob pattern, e.g. '*.pdf' or 'report'.

description: List the contents of a directory.
name: list_files

long_format.description: Show permissions, owner and modification time. Default: False.

path.description: Directory path, or a shortcut like 'home', 'desktop', 'downloads'. Default: 'home'.

description: Read a text file; every line is prefixed with its line number. Read a file with this before editing it with edit_file or overwriting it with write_file. For a long file read it in pieces with start_line.
name: read_file

start_line.description: 1-indexed line to start from; use the value the previous read printed after 'continue with start_line='. Default: 1.

description: Look up what has been remembered about the owner. Read-only; to store a fact use memory.
name: recall

query.description: Text to search keys and values for. Omit to list everything. Default: ''.

description: Search inside file contents under a directory (like grep -rn / rg). Output is capped and paged; narrow it with glob or a more specific directory, or continue with offset. To find files by name use find_files.
name: search_text

context_lines.description: Lines of context to show around each match (0-10). Default: 0.

glob.description: Only search files whose name matches, e.g. '*.py'. Default: ''.

max_results.description: Maximum results per page (1-200): matching lines, or files for the files and count outputs. Default: 40.

offset.description: Skip this many results first; use the value the previous page printed after 'continue with offset='. Default: 0.

output.description: 'content' lists matching lines (default), 'files' lists only the files that match, 'count' gives the number of matches per file. Default: 'content'.

query.description: Text to look for (case-insensitive). Plain text unless regex is true.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression. Default: False.

description: Search the web and return result titles, snippets and links.
name: web_search

max_results.description: How many results to return. Default: 6.
